gen-gf-turret-road-gf-noto-sans-linear-b: Commanding in its round, wire-cut curves, Turret Road leads with real presence. Noto Sans Linear B follows with a smooth, unobstructed path around each bend, and that easy flow is the pair's best quality.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-noto-sans-manichae: Turret Road draws its rounded strokes like cut lengths of cord, bold and unmodulated across the whole line. Noto Sans Manichaean keeps its crossbars open.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-noto-sans-mongolia: Rope-thick curves, then flared terminals. Turret Road carries the weight up top, while Noto Sans Mongolian reads smoothly down a long page, its modern sans-serif outlines flaring gently at each stroke end.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-noto-sans-new-tai-: Bold and unfussy, with no calligraphic swing. Noto Sans New Tai Lue lets a long passage unfold gently, its rounded sans letters cupped rather than clenched.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-noto-sans-nko: Noto Sans NKo is modern and see-through. Turret Road's pen-plotter smoothness takes the headline, so a modest body size is enough for the plain sans to hold its own beneath it.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-noto-sans-nko-unjo: Turret Road is the one for round, bold curves that never thin out, a heading with real command. And Noto Sans NKo Unjoined does the opposite job, giving small letters wide, approachable openings.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-noto-sans-old-sout: Noto Sans Old South Arabian reads approachable and clean, its curved strokes stopping before they turn inward. And Turret Road does what it does best, drawing bold round forms with a fixed pen.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-noto-sans-shavian: Noto Sans Shavian brings rope-loose curves that never knot at the ends. Noto Sans Shavian gives Turret Road's marker-like constant line a clean, contemporary sans partner underneath.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-ojuju: Bold round heading, then a springy sans-serif beneath. Turret Road keeps one fixed nib width throughout, while Ojuju lightens its curves mildly toward the ends and softens the page.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-overpass: Overpass reads modern and businesslike, with bold-looking and light-looking strokes never mixing inside a word. Overpass gives Turret Road's round, commanding display letters a sturdy sans-serif to stand on.
